messages:
Ellen: hi team — final draft of company OKRs for the upcoming quarter is up. Pls review and flag any blockers by EOD. doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/okrs/q3-draft

Raj: quick q — the 'private deployment for regulated customers' KR: is that full VPC offering or just an on-prem pilot? customers are asking for SAML + KMS now.

Ellen: it's intended as MVP = VPC + KMS integration for the top 3 customers. on-prem package is stretch / later. I'll reflect that in the KR.

Carlos: heads-up: Dedicated pool autoscale + SLA work would need ~3 sprints for perf and infra changes. can we reduce scope to 'reserved capacity for 50% throughput' and iterate?

Megan: sales side — customer F, G asked specifically for predictable latency and audit logs. If we can't promise full on-prem this quarter, we need clear launch criteria they can sign off on.

Sophia: legal: minimal compliance for regulated customers = audit logs retained 1y, KMS/HSM + RBAC audit. include as explicit acceptance criteria. also data residency notes.

Jordan: from exec: keep cost/latency KR measurable. propose P99 gen latency <200ms for hosted API, and cost/unit < $0.005 token for standard workload. owners?

Ellen: noted. Proposed changes: move 'on-prem' to stretch; add acceptance criteria: KMS + audit logs + RBAC, P99 <200ms, documented migration path. Owners: Carlos (infra), Anya (runtime), Megan (sales owner), Sophia (legal). I'll update doc.

Carlos: ok for infra owner, but request to add a canary rollout + automatic fallback policy in launch criteria.

Anya: will own runtime perf & quantization profile. we need load test plan + baseline prompts — I'll submit a test set by Tue.

Megan: sales ✅ — I'll prep customer communication and pilot invites for Customer F.

Raj: small ask — can we scope KR for 'model versioning + rollback' to include automated metrics comparison? otherwise rollback is dangerous.

Ellen: agreed, adding 'automated quality regressions alerting + rollback' to launch criteria.

deploy-bot: Reminder: exec OKR sign-off meeting scheduled tomorrow 09:00. https://cal.link/okrs-signoff

Ellen: ok — who can sign off now? please respond with :thumbsup: if you approve updates.

Carlos: :thumbsup:

Megan: :rocket:

Anya: :thumbsup:

Raj: +1 (please add regression test for embeddings)

Sophia: :thumbsup: (legal reviewed)

Jordan: :thumbsup:

Ellen: thanks — got approvals from engineering, sales, legal, exec. I'll merge changes and send final to execs. If anything major shows up overnight ping me. Closing thread.
